Gitboard serves as a local code-change dashboard for GitLab and GitHub repositories. It provides a centralized interface for monitoring CI status, tracking open Merge Requests, and triaging failed jobs. By integrating with local `gh`, `glab`, and `git` installations, it synchronizes remote forge data with local developer workflows, including local checkout and worktree state.
